note: Smyth County GIS sells zoning district layers and maps for a fee (GIS Coordinator, Manuel Street). The county WebGIS viewer (webgis.net/va/Smyth) has no public ArcGIS REST zoning service: the VA folder directory on webgis.net lists no Smyth service, and a SmythCo_WebGIS zoning URL surfaced in search returns 'not found'. Town of Marion, Saltville and Chilhowie have no queryable zoning service found either. Zoning ordinance map is official only as a purchasable product.
